1	# AI Insights
     2	
     3	AI coding agents forget everything between chat sessions. AI Insights fixes that — it gives agents persistent memory, defined roles, and a repeatable pipeline so complex projects survive across sessions without losing context.
     4	
     5	---
     6	
     7	## What's Inside
     8	
     9	### Agent Personas
    10	
    11	**Are you here to make your own personas?** [Start Here](https://mistralys.github.io/ai-insights/)
    12	
    13	Each persona is a carefully crafted prompt file that turns a general-purpose AI into a specialist — a code reviewer, a security auditor, a release engineer. Load one in your IDE (VS Code / Claude Code) and the agent knows its job, its boundaries, and how to hand off to the next stage. The system prioritizes robust persona reliability over complex, constantly changing toolsets.
    14	
    15	The following persona suites are available:
    16	
    17	| Suite | Description | Docs |
    18	|-------|-------------|------|
    19	| **Ledger** | Full 9-stage workflow (Planner → PM → Developer → QA → Security → Reviewer → Release → Docs → Synthesis) with persistent state via the MCP server | [personas/ledger/README.md](personas/ledger/README.md) |
    20	| **Ledger Support** | Utility agents that extend the ledger workflow — PM sub-agents, ledger doctor, orchestrator runner, and more | [personas/ledger-support/README.md](personas/ledger-support/README.md) |
    21	| **Standalone** | Drop-in agents with no dependencies — pick one and go | [personas/standalone/](personas/standalone/) |
    22	
    23	### Skills
    24	
    25	Reusable AI agent workflows that can be invoked directly from VS Code (via GitHub Copilot) or Claude Code. Skills delegate to a named persona at runtime — for example, the `insights-audit-persona` skill launches the Persona Curator in Audit mode to evaluate a persona against the Persona Design Guide.
    26	
    27	Source files live in `skills/`. Build output goes to `dist/vscode-skills/` and `dist/claude-skills/` (gitignored). To build and deploy:
    28	
    29	```bash
    30	node scripts/build-skills.js           # compile to dist/
    31	node scripts/build-skills.js --check   # verify only (no files written)
    32	node scripts/publish-skills.js         # deploy to .github/skills/ and ~/.claude/skills/
    33	```
    34	
    35	→ [skills/README.md](skills/README.md) — adding skills, metadata fields, output layout, and runtime dependencies
    36	
    37	### The Project Ledger
    38	
    39	The reason agents can pick up where the last one left off. This [MCP server](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/) stores project state — work packages, progress, handoff notes — so every agent in the pipeline sees the full history. A built-in knowledge store captures insights across runs, giving your agents institutional memory that grows over time.
    40	
    41	→ [mcp-server/README.md](mcp-server/README.md)
    42	
    43	### The Orchestrator
    44	
    45	Run the entire 9-stage pipeline from the command line — no IDE required. Built on **LangGraph** + **Deep Agents**, the orchestrator executes the same MCP-backed workflow headlessly. Useful for automation, CI integration, or when you want to kick off a pipeline and walk away.
    46	
    47	→ [orchestrator/README.md](orchestrator/README.md)
    48	
    49	---
    50	
    51	## Requirements
    52	
    53	- **Node.js** >= 18
    54	- **Python 3.11+** (only for the orchestrator)
    55	
    56	---
    57	
    58	## 🚀 Quick Start
    59	
    60	Everything runs through a single interactive menu:
    61	
    62	```bash
    63	./menu.sh          # macOS / Linux
    64	menu.cmd           # Windows
    65	```
    66	
    67	On **first launch**, the menu walks you through setup automatically — installing dependencies, building the MCP server, syncing personas to your IDE, and registering everything globally. No manual steps required.
    68	
    69	After that, the menu monitors your workspace for stale builds and configuration drift. Just open it — it keeps itself current.
    70	
    71	→ [docs/references/menu-guide.md](docs/references/menu-guide.md) — full menu reference and direct commands

1	# Project Ledger MCP Server
     2	
     3	**A Model Context Protocol server that keeps AI coding agents in sync across sessions.**
     4	
     5	---
     6	
     7	## What Is This?
     8	
     9	The Project Ledger MCP Server manages persistent project state for multi-agent AI workflows. It acts as a shared "source of truth" so agents can track progress, coordinate handoffs, and preserve context — even when you start a new chat session.
    10	
    11	### The Problem It Solves
    12	
    13	- **Context loss** — each new chat session starts from scratch
    14	- **Duplicate work** — agents redo completed tasks or miss dependencies
    15	- **Data corruption** — manual JSON editing causes schema violations
    16	- **Race conditions** — multiple agents editing the same files simultaneously
    17	
    18	### How It Helps
    19	
    20	- **Persists state** as validated JSON on disk across sessions
    21	- **Prevents corruption** with atomic writes and file locking
    22	- **Coordinates agents** by telling each one what to do next
    23	- **Tracks knowledge** across projects for future planning
    24	
    25	---
    26	
    27	## Quick Start
    28	
    29	From the workspace root, use the interactive menu:
    30	
    31	```bash
    32	./menu.sh          # macOS / Linux
    33	menu.cmd           # Windows
    34	```
    35	
    36	On first launch the menu auto-detects missing components and runs the setup wizard — this installs dependencies, builds the MCP server, and registers it in your IDE. **No manual `npm install` or `npm run build` needed.**
    37	
    38	The menu also displays a live health status showing whether the MCP server dist is current. If source files have changed, the orchestrator launcher will rebuild automatically before starting a run.
    39	
    40	### Registering the Server in Your IDE
    41	
    42	The first-time setup wizard handles this automatically. To re-register later:
    43	
    44	```bash
    45	./menu.sh install-mcp              # register in VS Code + Claude Code
    46	./menu.sh install-mcp --dry-run    # preview without writing
    47	```
    48	
    49	This installs a stable shim at `~/.ai-insights/bin/launch-server.js` and registers the `central_pm` server in your IDE's user-level MCP configuration. No manual path editing required.
    50	
    51	### Launching the GUI Dashboard
    52	
    53	```bash
    54	./menu.sh gui
    55	```
    56	
    57	Opens [http://localhost:3420](http://localhost:3420) — a web dashboard for monitoring projects, viewing work packages, browsing orchestrator dialogues, managing the knowledge base, and **launching orchestrator runs** directly from the browser.
    58	
    59	---
    60	
    61	## Features
    62	
    63	- **30 MCP tools** for complete project lifecycle management
    64	- **Atomic operations** — write-to-temp-then-rename prevents partial writes
    65	- **File locking** — distributed locks with stale detection and retry logic
    66	- **Schema validation** — all data validated with Zod on every read/write
    67	- **Auto-handoff** — agents are automatically routed to the next stage
    68	- **Infinite-loop protection** — depth counter prevents runaway handoff chains
    69	- **Knowledge base** — persistent cross-project insights with full-text search
    70	- **Strategic vision** — repository-level planning with three-horizon goals
    71	- **Self-healing counters** — auto-corrects counter drift on status queries
    72	- **GUI dashboard** — web UI for monitoring, search, filtering, dark mode
    73	
    74	---
    75	
    76	## Setup
    77	
    78	### Prerequisites
    79	
    80	- **Node.js** >= 18 (ESM-compatible)
    81	- **npm** or compatible package manager
    82	
    83	### Installation
    84	
    85	The CLI menu handles installation automatically (see Quick Start above). For standalone or CI use:
    86	
    87	```bash
    88	cd mcp-server
    89	npm install
    90	npm run build
    91	```
    92	
    93	### Manual IDE Configuration (Advanced)
    94	
    95	If you prefer to configure your IDE manually rather than using `./menu.sh install-mcp`:
    96	
    97	Add the server to your `.mcp.json` (or MCP configuration file):
    98	
    99	```json
   100	{

101	  "mcpServers": {
   102	    "project-ledger": {
   103	      "command": "npx",
   104	      "args": ["tsx", "/absolute/path/to/ai-insights/mcp-server/src/index.ts"]
   105	    }
   106	  }
   107	}
   108	```
   109	
   110	**Optional: Custom agents directory** — to enable auto-handoff, pass `--agents-dir`:
   111	
   112	```json
   113	{
   114	  "mcpServers": {
   115	    "project-ledger": {
   116	      "command": "npx",
   117	      "args": [
   118	        "tsx",
   119	        "/absolute/path/to/ai-insights/mcp-server/src/index.ts",
   120	        "--agents-dir",
   121	        "/absolute/path/to/your/prompts"
   122	      ]
   123	    }
   124	  }
   125	}
   126	```
   127	
   128	By default the server auto-detects the VS Code User prompts folder for the current platform.
   129	
   130	---
   131	
   132	## Available Tools
   133	
   134	The server exposes **30 MCP tools** organized by category:
   135	
   136	| Category | Tools |
   137	|----------|-------|
   138	| **Project Lifecycle** | `ledger_get_project_status`, `ledger_initialize_project`, `ledger_list_projects`, `ledger_detect_project`, `ledger_complete_synthesis`, `ledger_import_standalone` |
   139	| **Repository Context** | `ledger_get_repository_context` |
   140	| **Work Packages** | `ledger_get_work_package`, `ledger_list_work_packages`, `ledger_create_work_package`, `ledger_claim_work_package`, `ledger_update_work_package_status`, `ledger_reset_rework_count`, `ledger_reopen_cancelled_wp`, `ledger_update_acceptance_criteria` |
   141	| **Pipelines** | `ledger_begin_work`, `ledger_start_pipeline`, `ledger_complete_pipeline`, `ledger_cancel_pipeline`, `ledger_update_pipeline_progress` |
   142	| **Knowledge** | `ledger_add_insight`, `ledger_search_insights`, `ledger_list_insights`, `ledger_update_insight`, `ledger_delete_insight` |
   143	| **Observations** | `ledger_add_observation`, `ledger_add_project_comment` |
   144	| **Workflow** | `ledger_get_next_action`, `ledger_get_handoff_status` |
   145	| **Help** | `ledger_help` |
   146	
   147	> **Note:** `ledger_import_standalone` has atypical `cwd_path` semantics — it expects the plan
   148	> folder path directly (the directory containing `plan.md`/`synthesis.md`), not the workspace
   149	> root. All other tools use `cwd_path` as the workspace root for auto-project detection.
   150	
   151	For detailed API signatures and parameters, see the [API Surface](docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md).
   152	
   153	---
   154	
   155	## Troubleshooting
   156	
   157	### "MCP server unavailable"
   158	
   159	1. Verify `.mcp.json` exists and points to the correct path
   160	2. Ensure dependencies are installed: `cd mcp-server && npm install`
   161	3. Restart your AI IDE to reload MCP configuration
   162	
   163	### MCP Tool Call Fails
   164	
   165	1. Check that `project_path` arguments are absolute paths
   166	2. Verify ledger files haven't been manually edited or corrupted
   167	3. Look for schema validation errors in the error message
   168	
   169	### Lock Acquisition Timeout
   170	
   171	1. Another process may be holding the lock — wait and retry
   172	2. If a process crashed, delete the `.lock` file inside `storage/ledger/{slug}/`
   173	3. Use `./menu.sh kill-orchestrator` to clean up stale processes
   174	
   175	---
   176	
   177	## Development
   178	
   179	### Running Tests
   180	
   181	```bash
   182	cd mcp-server
   183	npm test              # run all tests once
   184	npm run test:watch    # run tests in watch mode
   185	```
   186	
   187	### Building
   188	
   189	```bash
   190	npm run build         # compile TypeScript to dist/
   191	npm run dev           # run server with tsx (auto-reload)
   192	```
   193	
   194	### Versioning
   195	
   196	This project uses `changelog.md` as the source of truth. After updating the changelog:
   197	
   198	```bash
   199	npm run sync-version  # extracts version from changelog → package.json
   200	```
   201	
   202	### npm Scripts
   203	
   204	| Script | Description |
   205	|--------|-------------|
   206	| `npm run build` | Compile TypeScript source to `dist/` |
   207	| `npm run dev` | Run server with `tsx` (auto-reload) |
   208	| `npm test` | Run all tests once |
   209	| `npm run test:watch` | Run tests in watch mode |
   210	| `npm run sync-version` | Sync version from `changelog.md` to `package.json` |
   211	| `npm run gui` | Start the GUI server (advanced — prefer `./menu.sh gui` from root) |
   212	
   213	---
   214	
   215	## Technical Documentation
   216	
   217	For developers who want to understand the internals:
   218	
   219	| Resource | Description |
   220	|----------|-------------|
   221	| [Project Manifest](docs/agents/project-manifest/) | Comprehensive technical documentation hub |
   222	| [Tech Stack & Patterns](docs/agents/project-manifest/tech-stack.md) | Runtime, frameworks, architectural patterns |
   223	| [Public API Surface](docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md) | All tool signatures and parameters |
   224	| [Data Flows](docs/agents/project-manifest/data-flows.md) | How data moves through the system |
   225	| [Constraints](docs/agents/project-manifest/constraints.md) | Architectural invariants and conventions |
   226	| [GUI internals](docs/agents/project-manifest/api-surface.md) | GUI backend modules, frontend views, API handlers |
   227	
   228	---
   229	
   230	## Related
   231	
   232	- [Ledger-Enabled Agent Workflow](../personas/ledger/) — How to use this server with AI agents
   233	- [Agent Personas](../personas/ledger/) — The 9 agents that use this server
   234	- [Orchestrator](../orchestrator/) — Headless pipeline executor

1	# Public API Surface — MCP Server GUI
     2	
     3	---
     4	
     5	## 1. Backend REST API
     6	
     7	All routes are prefixed with `/api`. Response envelope on success: raw JSON value. Error envelope: `{ error: { code, message } }`.
     8	
     9	### Error Codes → HTTP Status
    10	
    11	| Code | Status |
    12	|------|--------|
    13	| `NOT_FOUND` | 404 |
    14	| `FORBIDDEN` | 403 |
    15	| `VALIDATION_ERROR` | 400 |
    16	| `CONFLICT` | 409 |
    17	| `PAYLOAD_TOO_LARGE` | 413 |
    18	| *(unhandled)* | 500 |
    19	
    20	---
    21	
    22	### 1.1 Projects
    23	
    24	| Method | Path | Handler | Description |
    25	|--------|------|---------|-------------|
    26	| `GET` | `/api/projects` | `handleListProjects` | Paginated list with filtering, sorting, search. |
    27	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug` | `handleGetProject` | Full project detail (root index + meta). |
    28	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/plan` | `handleGetPlanDocument` | Plan Markdown content. |
    29	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/synthesis` | `handleGetSynthesisDocument` | Synthesis Markdown content. |
    30	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/health` | `handleGetProjectHealth` | Health summary. |
    31	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/run-metadata` | `handleGetRunMetadata` | `.orchestrator-run.json` sidecar. |
    32	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/work-packages` | `handleListWorkPackages` | All WPs for a project. |
    33	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/work-packages/overview` | `handleGetWorkPackageOverview` | Aggregate WP status summary. |
    34	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/work-packages/:wpId` | `handleGetWorkPackage` | Single WP detail. |
    35	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/dialogues` | `handleListDialogues` | Dialogue file list (optional `?wp=` filter). |
    36	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/dialogues/:filename` | `handleGetDialogueFile` | Single dialogue content. |
    37	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/chunks` | `handleListChunks` | Chunk file list (optional `?wp=` filter). |
    38	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/chunks/:filename` | `handleGetChunkFile` | Raw chunk JSONL content. |
    39	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/chunks/:filename/rendered` | `handleGetChunkFile` + `renderChunksToDialogue` / `renderChunksToStructured` | Rendered chunk. Without `?format=structured`: Markdown string (`{ content }`) — compact chat-like format, plain paragraphs, per-tool summaries. With `?format=structured`: JSON array (`{ blocks: DialogueBlock[] }`) for interactive frontend rendering. |
    40	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/runs` | `handleListRunLogs` | Orchestrator run log file list. |
    41	| `GET` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/runs/:filename` | `handleGetRunLog` | Log entries (supports `?after=N` for streaming). |
    42	| `DELETE` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug` | `handleDeleteProject` | Permanently delete a project. |
    43	| `PATCH` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug` | `handleRenameProject` | Rename title or slug. Body: `{ title?: string, slug?: string }`. |
    44	| `POST` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/archive` | `handleArchiveProject` | Set status to ARCHIVED. |
    45	| `POST` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/unarchive` | `handleUnarchiveProject` | Restore from ARCHIVED. |
    46	| `POST` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/complete` | `handleMarkProjectComplete` | Mark project COMPLETE. |
    47	| `POST` | `/api/projects/:repo/:slug/reset` | `handleResetProject` | Reset project (dry_run or apply). Body: `{ dry_run: boolean, decisions?: [] }`. |
    48	
    49	#### GET /api/projects Query Parameters
    50	
    51	| Param | Type | Default | Description |
    52	|-------|------|---------|-------------|
    53	| `page` | number | 1 | Page number (1-indexed). |
    54	| `limit` | number | 50 | Items per page (max 200). |
    55	| `status` | string | `'ACTIVE'` | `'ACTIVE'`, `'ALL'`, or a specific status value. |
    56	| `search` | string | — | Case-insensitive substring match on slug, name, repo. |
    57	| `sort` | string | `'last_updated'` | Column: `project`, `repository`, `status`, `total_work_packages`, `done`, `date_created`, `last_updated`, `runner`. |
    58	| `dir` | string | `'desc'` | `'asc'` or `'desc'`. |
    59	| `runner` | string | — | Filter: `'orchestrator'`, `'vscode'`, `'claude-code'`, `'unknown'`. |
    60	
    61	#### GET /api/projects Response Envelope (`ProjectListEnvelope`)
    62	
    63	```typescript
    64	{
    65	  projects: ProjectSummary[];
    66	  total: number;
    67	  page: number;
    68	  limit: number;
    69	  total_pages: number;
    70	  status_counts: Record<string, number>;
    71	  runner_counts: Record<string, number>;
    72	}
    73	```
    74	
    75	---
    76	
    77	### 1.2 Orchestrator
    78	
    79	| Method | Path | Handler | Description |
    80	|--------|------|---------|-------------|
    81	| `GET` | `/api/orchestrator/queue` | `handleGetOrchestratorQueue` | Current queue entries with effective status. |
    82	| `GET` | `/api/orchestrator/run-status/:filename` | `handleGetRunStatus` | Status from a specific log file. |

    86

    88	
    89	### 1.3 Knowledge
    90

101	### 1.4 Model Registry
   102	
   103	All routes are handled by `api-models.ts`. Body-parsing routes live inline in `server.ts handleRequest()`; GET routes are registered in `matchRoute()`.
   104	
   105	| Method | Path | Handler | Description |
   106	|--------|------|---------|-------------|
   107	| `GET` | `/api/models` | `handleGetModels` | Returns model list. Auto-initializes `local.json` from `default.json` on first access. |
   108	| `PUT` | `/api/models` | `handleSaveModels` | Bulk-save the model list. Auto-assigns UUIDv4 to entries without `id`. Returns 409 when a deletion would remove a referenced model. |
   109	| `POST` | `/api/models/load-defaults` | `handleLoadDefaults` | Merge `default.json` into `local.json` without overwriting existing entries. Returns `{ models, conflicts }`. |
   110	
   111	#### PUT /api/models Request Body
   112	
   113	Array of model entries validated by `SaveModelsBodySchema`:
   114	
   115	```typescript
   116	Array<{
   117	  id?: string;          // UUIDv4 — omit to auto-assign
   118	  name: string;         // Display name (min 1 char)
   119	  slug: string;         // Lowercase kebab-case (regex: /^[a-z0-9]+(-[a-z0-9]+)*$/)
   120	  cc_model?: string;    // Claude Code model identifier (default: "inherit")
   121	}>
   122	```
   123	
   124	**Validation rules:**
   125	- Duplicate `slug` values → 400
   126	- Reserved slug `"inherit"` on a non-sentinel entry → 400
   127	- Removing a model that is referenced in assignments → 409 with `referencedModels` details (user must use Replace Model first)
   128	
   129	#### PUT /api/models Response
   130	
   131	```typescript
   132	// Success
   133	{ models: ModelEntry[] }
   134	
   135	// 409 Conflict (referenced model deletion blocked)
   136	{
   137	  conflict: true;
   138	  referencedModels: Array<{ model: ModelEntry; usages: string[] }>;
   139	}
   140	```
   141	
   142	---
   143	
   144	### 1.5 Model Assignments
   145	
   146	| Method | Path | Handler | Description |
   147	|--------|------|---------|-------------|
   148	| `GET` | `/api/model-assignments` | `handleGetAssignments` | Returns assignments enriched with `stale` boolean. |
   149	| `PUT` | `/api/model-assignments` | `handleUpdateAssignments` | Validate and persist assignments. Returns 400 when `name-mapping.json` is absent or invalid. |
   150	| `POST` | `/api/model-assignments/replace` | `handleReplaceAssignedModel` | Swap all occurrences of `old_model_id` with `new_model_id`. Returns 400 for same-model swap or unreferenced source. |
   151	
   152	#### GET /api/model-assignments Response
   153	
   154	```typescript
   155	{
   156	  default_model_uuid?: string;              // Optional global default
   157	  persona_models: Record<string, string>;   // Persona ID → model UUID
   158	  stale: boolean;                           // See staleness rules below
   159	}
   160	```
   161	
   162	**Staleness rules for `stale`:**
   163	
   164	| Condition | `stale` |
   165	|-----------|---------|
   166	| `max(mtime(assignments.json), mtime(local.json))` > `mtime(name-mapping.json)` | `true` — rebuild needed |
   167	| Neither `assignments.json` nor `local.json` exist | `false` — no user changes yet |
   168	| `name-mapping.json` does not exist | `false` — no build output to compare |
   169	| Only `default.json` is newer than `name-mapping.json` | `false` — Git checkout mtime, not a user change |
   170	
   171	#### PUT /api/model-assignments Request Body
   172	
   173	```typescript
   174	{
   175	  default_model_uuid?: string;             // Must exist in model registry if provided
   176	  persona_models: Record<string, string>;  // Key: persona id from name-mapping.json; Value: model UUID
   177	}
   178	```
   179	
   180	**Validation rules:**
   181	- `name-mapping.json` must exist → 400 if absent
   182	- All persona keys in `persona_models` must appear as `id` values in `name-mapping.json` → 400 if invalid
   183	- All model UUIDs (including `default_model_uuid`) must exist in the registry → 400 if not found
   184	
   185	#### POST /api/model-assignments/replace Request Body
   186	
   187	```typescript
   188	{ old_model_id: string; new_model_id: string }  // Both must be UUIDs in registry
   189	```
   190	
   191	**Rejection conditions (400):**
   192	- `old_model_id === new_model_id` — "Source and target models must be different"
   193	- `old_model_id` not referenced in any assignment — "Model is not referenced in any current assignment"
   194	
   195	---
   196	
   197	### 1.6 Personas
   198	
   199	| Method | Path | Handler | Description |
   200	|--------|------|---------|-------------|
   201	| `GET` | `/api/personas` | `handleGetPersonas` | Returns all entries from `name-mapping.json`, or empty array if file absent. Returns 400 if file is malformed JSON. |
   202	| `POST` | `/api/personas/rebuild` | `handleRebuildPersonas` | Spawns `node scripts/build-personas.js`. Returns 409 when a build is already in progress. |
   203	
   204	#### GET /api/personas Response
   205	
   206	Array of `PersonaEntry` objects:
   207	
   208	```typescript
   209	interface PersonaEntry {
   210	  id: string;          // Persona identifier — use as key in PUT /api/model-assignments
   211	  role: string;        // Human-readable display name
   212	  suite: string;       // Persona suite (e.g. "ledger", "standalone")
   213	  model?: string;      // Resolved model name (populated after build)
   214	  model_slug?: string; // Matching ModelEntry.slug in local registry
   215	  cc_model?: string;   // Effective Claude Code model identifier
   216	  number?: number;     // Display ordering index within the suite
   217	}
   218	```
   219	
   220	Optional fields are only populated after WP-003 is implemented and a build has run.
   221	
   222	#### POST /api/personas/rebuild Response
   223	
   224	```typescript
   225	// Exit code 0
   226	{ success: true; output: string }
   227	
   228	// Non-zero exit code → HTTP 500
   229	{ success: false; output: string; exitCode: number }
   230	
   231	// Build already running → HTTP 409
   232	{ error: { code: 'CONFLICT'; message: string } }
   233	```
   234	
   235	The `buildInProgress` module-level flag prevents concurrent builds. It is cleared in a `finally` block so process errors never leave the guard permanently set.
   236	
   237	---
   238

   245	| `GET` | `/api/server-info` | *(inline)* | Boot vs disk versions + stale flag. |
